item.title: Multiple Networks - Increased Latencies (Token/Portfolio API) [resolved]
item.description:
This incident has been resolved. Between approximately 21:58 UTC and 22:12 UTC, some API requests across multiple networks experienced elevated latency, primarily affecting Token API and Portfolio API balance lookups.
All services are currently operating normally. We will continue to investigate the underlying cause to prevent recurrence!

item.title: [Network Wide] Xdc Testnet Chain Stalled [resolved]
[Network Wide] Zetachain Mainnet Block Production Stalled [resolved]
Unichain Mainnet - safe/finalized head stalled in use1 [resolved]
item.description:
A subset of nodes serving Unichain Mainnet in our US East (use1) region experienced stalled safe/finalized block tracking, causing delayed safe/finalized block data for requests routed through that region. The latest block head and overall API serving were unaffected throughout and no elevated error rates were observed.
We performed a rolling restart of the affected nodes, which resolved the issue. Safe/finalized data is now current and within normal lag across the region.
This incident is resolved!
